bio.text: Kendra Moore is serving her second term in the Arkansas House, representing District 23, which includes a portion of Washington County; she lives in Lincoln.
Before the House she served on the board of education of the Lincoln Consolidated School District.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Arkansas and an MBA from John Brown University, and owns Redeemed Construction and Renovation, LLC.
